tool_schemas.name: todoist_task_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new task in the Todoist workspace for the given connection and returns the created task record (including its assigned id and stored due fields). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid, ids do not match their expected prefixes, or if section_id is provided but does not belong to the given project_id; raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced project_id, section_id, parent_task_id, or any label_ids do not exist in the workspace. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection_id is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the requested hierarchy/state is not allowed (for example, parenting under an incompatible task).

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) whose workspace to operate on.

project_id.description: Project container id (tdcnb_... ULID) to place the task in.

section_id.description: Section container id (tdcnb_... ULID) to place the task in (must belong to the project).

parent_task_id.description: Parent task id (tdtsk_... ULID) to create this as a subtask.

due_string.description: Natural-language due string (stored as raw due_string_raw).

due_date.description: Explicit due datetime (overrides due_string if both provided).

due_timezone.description: IANA timezone name for the due date/time (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles').

label_ids.description: List of label ids (tdlbl_... ULID) to apply to the task.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_task_get
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves either a single task by task_id or a filtered list of tasks in the connection’s workspace, returning results sorted as requested and paged with limit and an opaque cursor (omit cursor for the first page; the response includes the next cursor when more results exist). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameter combinations or formats (including invalid enum values, limit out of range, or malformed ids), and NOT_FOUND when task_id is provided but no matching task exists in the workspace. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection_id is not accessible.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) whose workspace to read from.

task_id.description: Specific task id (tdtsk_... ULID) to fetch.

query.description: Case-insensitive partial content search string to filter tasks.

project_id.description: Filter by project container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

section_id.description: Filter by section container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

parent_task_id.description: Filter by parent task id (tdtsk_... ULID) to list subtasks.

label_ids.description: Filter to tasks that have these label ids (tdlbl_... ULID).

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_task_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates a single task identified by task_id or, when task_id is omitted, by resolving query to exactly one matching task, and returns the updated task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither task_id nor query is provided, if query matches zero or multiple tasks, if any ids/enums/formats are invalid, or if section_id is provided without a compatible project_id/relationship; raises NOT_FOUND if the target task (or referenced project/section/labels) does not exist in the workspace. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection_id is not accessible, and CONFLICT when the requested move or hierarchy/state change is not permitted (for example, moving into an incompatible section/project pairing).

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) whose workspace to operate on.

query.description: Case-insensitive partial content search used to find a single task to update when task_id is not provided.

due_string.description: New natural-language due string (stored as raw due_string_raw).

due_timezone.description: New IANA timezone for due date/time.

label_ids.description: Replace labels with this set of label ids (tdlbl_... ULID).

project_id.description: Move task to this project container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

section_id.description: Move task to this section container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: todoist_task_delete
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a single task identified by task_id or, when task_id is omitted, by resolving query to exactly one matching task, and returns the deleted task (or a deletion confirmation for that task id). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither task_id nor query is provided, if query matches zero or multiple tasks, or if ids are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the target task cannot be found in the workspace. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection_id is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the task cannot be deleted due to its current state or constraints.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) whose workspace to operate on.

query.description: Case-insensitive partial content search used to find a single task to delete when task_id is not provided.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_task_complete
tool_schemas.description: Marks a single task as completed, identified by task_id or, when task_id is omitted, by resolving query to exactly one matching task, and returns the updated (completed) task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither task_id nor query is provided, if query matches zero or multiple tasks, or if ids are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the target task cannot be found in the workspace. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection_id is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the task is already completed/deleted or cannot transition to completed from its current state.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) whose workspace to operate on.

task_id.description: Task id (tdtsk_... ULID) to mark complete.

query.description: Case-insensitive partial content search used to find a single task to complete when task_id is not provided.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_tasks_bulk_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple tasks in a single call for the given connection and returns the list of created task records in the same order as provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tasks is empty, any task is missing required fields (content), any field value is invalid, or a task specifies a section_id that does not belong to its project_id; raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced project_id, section_id, parent_task_id, or label_ids do not exist in the workspace. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection_id is not accessible, and CONFLICT if any requested hierarchy/state is not allowed for one or more tasks (for example, invalid parent/child relationships).

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) whose workspace to operate on.

project_id.description: Project container id (tdcnb_... ULID) to place the task in.

section_id.description: Section container id (tdcnb_... ULID) to place the task in.

parent_task_id.description: Parent task id (tdtsk_... ULID) to create this as a subtask.

due_string.description: Natural-language due string (stored as raw due_string_raw).

due_date.description: Explicit due datetime (overrides due_string if both provided).

due_timezone.description: IANA timezone name for the due date/time.

label_ids.description: List of label ids (tdlbl_... ULID) to apply to the task.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_tasks_bulk_update
tool_schemas.description: Update multiple tasks at once based on search criteria. Very efficient for updating many tasks with the same changes.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) whose workspace to operate on.

query.description: Case-insensitive partial content search string to match tasks.

project_id.description: Match tasks in this project container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

section_id.description: Match tasks in this section container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

parent_task_id.description: Match tasks with this parent task id (tdtsk_... ULID).

label_ids.description: Match tasks that have these label ids (tdlbl_... ULID).

filter.description: Criteria used to select which tasks to update.

content.description: Set a new content/title for matched tasks.

description.description: Set a new description for matched tasks.

priority.description: Set a new priority for matched tasks.

due_string.description: Set a new natural-language due string for matched tasks.

due_date.description: Set a new explicit due datetime for matched tasks.

due_timezone.description: Set a new IANA timezone for due date/time for matched tasks.

deadline_at.description: Set a new deadline datetime for matched tasks.

label_ids.description: Replace labels on matched tasks with this set of label ids.

project_id.description: Move matched tasks to this project container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

section_id.description: Move matched tasks to this section container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

changes.description: Field changes to apply to all matched tasks.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_tasks_bulk_delete
tool_schemas.description: Delete multiple tasks at once based on search criteria. Use with caution - this will permanently delete matching tasks.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) whose workspace to operate on.

query.description: Case-insensitive partial content search string to match tasks.

project_id.description: Match tasks in this project container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

section_id.description: Match tasks in this section container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

parent_task_id.description: Match tasks with this parent task id (tdtsk_... ULID).

label_ids.description: Match tasks that have these label ids (tdlbl_... ULID).

filter.description: Criteria used to select which tasks to delete.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_tasks_bulk_complete
tool_schemas.description: Complete multiple tasks at once based on search criteria. Efficiently mark many tasks as done.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection ULID to operate on.

filters.description: Criteria used to select which tasks to complete.

project_id.description: Only complete tasks in this project container id.

section_id.description: Only complete tasks in this section container id.

parent_task_id.description: Only complete subtasks of this parent task id.

label_ids.description: Only complete tasks that have all of these label ids.

priority.description: Only complete tasks with this priority.

status.description: Task status filter (typically 'active' for bulk completion).

search.description: Text search applied to task content/description.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching tasks to complete in this call.

dry_run.description: If true, return the tasks that would be completed without changing state.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_project_get
tool_schemas.description: Get a list of all projects from Todoist with their IDs and names

connection_id.description: Todoist connection ULID to list projects for.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_section_get
tool_schemas.description: Lists sections in the specified project for the given connection and returns a page of section records (IDs, names, and metadata) filtered by status, ordered by the requested sort; pagination uses limit and a cursor returned from the previous call. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if connection_id/project_id are malformed, limit is out of range, or status/sort/sort_dir are not allowed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist for that connection, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection ULID to list sections for.

project_id.description: Project container id to list sections within.

limit.description: Maximum number of sections to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_project_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new project in the user’s Todoist workspace (optionally under parent_project_id) and returns the created project record with its assigned ID and stored fields (name, color, order_index, is_favorite). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including empty name) or IDs are malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if parent_project_id is provided but does not exist for that connection, CONFLICT if a project cannot be created due to a parent/state constraint, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection ULID to create the project under.

parent_project_id.description: Optional parent project container id to create a sub-project.

color.description: Project color identifier from Todoist (stored as a string).

order_index.description: Project order/index in the user's project list.

is_favorite.description: Whether the project is marked as favorite.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_section_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new section within the specified project and returns the created section record including its assigned ID, name, and ordering fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is empty, IDs are malformed, or order_index is invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist for that connection, CONFLICT if the section cannot be created due to project/state constraints, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection ULID to create the section under.

project_id.description: Project container id to create the section within.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_comment_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new comment and returns the created comment record; you must target either a task (by task_id, or by resolving task_name) or a project (project_id) as supported by the backend. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if content is empty, if neither a task nor project target can be determined, if both task and project targets are provided in a conflicting way, or if IDs are malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the referenced task/project (or task_name resolution) does not exist for that connection, CONFLICT if commenting is not allowed for the target’s current state, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection ULID to add the comment for.

task_id.description: Task id to add the comment to.

task_name.description: Task name to resolve to a task when task_id is not provided.

project_id.description: Project container id to add a project comment to (if supported by the backend).

tool_schemas.name: todoist_comment_get
tool_schemas.description: Lists comments for a task (task_id) or project (project_id) and returns a paged result filtered by status and ordered by the requested sort; pagination uses limit and a cursor returned from the previous call. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are malformed, if both task_id and project_id are provided, if neither is provided, or if limit/status/sort/sort_dir are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the referenced task/project does not exist for that connection, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection ULID to fetch comments for.

task_id.description: Task id to fetch comments for.

project_id.description: Project container id to fetch comments for.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_label_get
tool_schemas.description: Lists labels for the given connection and returns a page of label records filtered by status and ordered by the requested sort; pagination uses limit and a cursor returned from the previous call. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if connection_id is malformed or if limit/status/sort/sort_dir are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection ULID to list labels for.

limit.description: Maximum number of labels to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_label_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new label and returns the created label record including its assigned ID, name, color, and is_favorite. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is empty, connection_id is malformed, or provided fields fail validation. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, CONFLICT if the label cannot be created due to a uniqueness/state constraint, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) to create the label under.

color.description: Label color identifier/value as supported by Todoist (stored as string).

is_favorite.description: Whether the label is marked as a favorite.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_label_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates the specified label’s mutable fields (name, color, is_favorite) and returns the updated label record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if label_id/connection_id are malformed or if provided fields (e.g., empty name) are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the label does not exist for that connection, CONFLICT if the update violates a uniqueness/state constraint (for example renaming to an existing label), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) that owns the label.

label_id.description: Internal label id (tdlbl_... ULID) to update.

color.description: New label color identifier/value as supported by Todoist (stored as string).

is_favorite.description: Set whether the label is marked as a favorite.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_label_delete
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified label and returns a deletion acknowledgement (and/or the label record marked deleted, depending on representation) for that connection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if label_id/connection_id are malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the label does not exist for that connection, CONFLICT if the label is already deleted or cannot be deleted due to state constraints, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) that owns the label.

label_id.description: Internal label id (tdlbl_... ULID) to delete.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_label_stats
tool_schemas.description: Computes and returns label usage statistics for the connection (counts per label), optionally including deleted labels when include_deleted is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if connection_id is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) to compute label usage statistics for.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include deleted labels in the statistics.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_subtask_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new task as a subtask of the specified parent task within the given Todoist connection and returns the created task record. Validates ULID formats, requires non-empty content, and validates priority (1–4), RFC3339/ISO timestamps, and label ID formats when provided. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the connection/parent task (or specified project/section/labels) do not exist in that connection, and CONFLICT if the requested parent/placement is not allowed (for example, the section does not belong to the chosen project).

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) to create the subtask under.

parent_task_id.description: Internal task id (tdtsk_... ULID) of the parent task.

project_container_id.description: Project container id (tdcnb_... ULID) to place the subtask in (defaults to parent's project if omitted).

section_container_id.description: Section container id (tdcnb_... ULID) to place the subtask in.

due_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the due date/time.

due_string_raw.description: Natural-language due string as entered by the user (stored as raw string).

label_ids.description: List of internal label ids (tdlbl_... ULIDs) to assign to the subtask.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_subtasks_bulk_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple subtasks under the same parent task in a single request and returns the list of created task records in the same order as the input. Each item is validated the same as single subtask creation (non-empty content; valid priority/date formats; valid project/section/label IDs if provided). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the connection/parent task (or any referenced project/section/labels) do not exist in that connection, and CONFLICT if any subtask requests an invalid placement (for example, section/project mismatch); the operation is rejected on validation or referential errors.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) to create the subtasks under.

parent_task_id.description: Internal task id (tdtsk_... ULID) of the parent task for all created subtasks.

project_container_id.description: Project container id (tdcnb_... ULID) to place the subtask in.

section_container_id.description: Section container id (tdcnb_... ULID) to place the subtask in.

due_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the due date/time.

due_string_raw.description: Natural-language due string as entered by the user (stored as raw string).

label_ids.description: List of internal label ids (tdlbl_... ULIDs) to assign to the subtask.

subtasks.description: Subtasks to create under the parent task.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_task_convert_to_subtask
tool_schemas.description: Moves an existing task under a new parent task (converting it into a subtask) within the given connection and returns the updated task record. Validates ULID formats and ensures both tasks exist and are visible to the connection. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the connection/task/new parent task do not exist in that connection, and CONFLICT if the conversion is not permitted (for example, attempting to create a cycle by making a task a descendant of itself).

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) that owns the tasks.

task_id.description: Internal task id (tdtsk_... ULID) of the task to convert into a subtask.

new_parent_task_id.description: Internal task id (tdtsk_... ULID) of the task that will become the new parent.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_subtask_promote
tool_schemas.description: Removes the parent relationship from a subtask so it becomes a top-level task again, returning the updated task record. Validates ULID formats and ensures the task exists in the specified connection. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the connection/task does not exist in that connection, and CONFLICT if the task is not currently a subtask (no parent to remove) or the state transition is otherwise refused.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) that owns the subtask.

task_id.description: Internal task id (tdtsk_... ULID) of the subtask to promote.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_task_hierarchy_get
tool_schemas.description: Returns the specified root task along with its subtask tree up to max_depth (defaulting to the backend’s full traversal if omitted), optionally including completed and/or deleted subtasks. This endpoint does not page results; it returns a single hierarchical structure rooted at task_id constrained by the requested depth and filters. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the connection or root task does not exist in that connection, and VALIDATION_ERROR if max_depth is provided but is less than 1.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection ULID (todoist_connections.id) to scope the lookup.

task_id.description: Root task ULID (todoist_tasks.id) to fetch with its full subtask tree.

include_completed.description: Whether to include completed subtasks in the returned hierarchy.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include deleted subtasks in the returned hierarchy.

max_depth.description: Maximum subtask depth to traverse starting from the root task.

tool_schemas.name: todoist_test_connection
tool_schemas.description: Verifies that the stored Todoist connection can successfully authenticate against the Todoist API and returns a test result (including success/failure details). Validates the connection_id format and checks the remote token/authorization state. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the connection does not exist, and CONFLICT if the connection exists but is not in a usable/authenticated state (for example, revoked/invalid token).

connection_id.description: Todoist connection ULID (todoist_connections.id) to validate.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def todoist_test_connection(connection_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0360000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0360000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now = now_dt.isoformat() + "Z"

    def _record_run(conn_id, req_params, status, http_status=None, error_code=None, error_message=None, assertions=None):
        runs = _load("todoist_tool_runs.json")
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        import random
        def _gen_ulid_like(prefix):
            return prefix + "_" + "".join(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(26))
        rid = _gen_ulid_like("tdrun")
        duration_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        row = {
            "id": rid,
            "connection_id": conn_id,
            "tool_name": "todoist_test_connection",
            "request_params": req_params,
            "status": status,
            "http_status": http_status,
            "error_code": error_code,
            "error_message": error_message,
            "duration_ms": duration_ms if status in ("succeeded", "failed") else None,
            "assertions": assertions,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        runs.append(row)
        _save("todoist_tool_runs.json", runs)

    if not isinstance(connection_id, str):
        _record_run("unknown", {"connection_id": connection_id}, "failed", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR", error_message="connection_id must be a string")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "connection_id must be a string")
    if not re.match(r"^tdc_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$", connection_id):
        _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id}, "failed", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR", error_message="connection_id format is invalid")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "connection_id format is invalid")

    conns = _load("todoist_connections.json")
    idx = None
    conn = None
    for i, c in enumerate(conns):
        if c.get("id") == connection_id:
            idx = i
            conn = c
            break
    if not conn:
        _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id}, "failed", error_code="NOT_FOUND", error_message="Connection not found")
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Connection not found")

    if conn.get("status") == "disabled":
        _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id}, "failed", error_code="CONFLICT", error_message="Connection is disabled")
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Connection is disabled")

    # Offline "remote" validation model:
    # - api_token_ciphertext must exist and be non-empty
    # - If token_fingerprint contains "invalid" or api_token_ciphertext contains "invalid", treat as auth failure.
    api_ct = conn.get("api_token_ciphertext")
    fp = conn.get("token_fingerprint")
    if not isinstance(api_ct, str) or not api_ct.strip():
        # treat as auth failure
        new_status = "invalid_token"
        if conn.get("status") != new_status and conn.get("status") not in ("active", "invalid_token"):
            _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id}, "failed", error_code="INVALID_TRANSITION", error_message="Illegal status transition")
            return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Illegal status transition")
        conn["status"] = new_status
        conn["last_validated_at"] = now
        conn["last_error_code"] = "AUTH_FAILED"
        conn["last_error_message"] = "Missing token"
        conn["updated_at"] = now
        conns[idx] = conn
        _save("todoist_connections.json", conns)
        _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id}, "failed", http_status=401, error_code="UNAUTHORIZED", error_message="Authentication failed")
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Authentication failed", details={"http_status": 401})
    if (isinstance(fp, str) and "invalid" in fp.lower()) or ("invalid" in api_ct.lower()):
        # auth failure
        if conn.get("status") not in ("active", "invalid_token"):
            _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id}, "failed", error_code="INVALID_TRANSITION", error_message="Illegal status transition")
            return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Illegal status transition")
        conn["status"] = "invalid_token"
        conn["last_validated_at"] = now
        conn["last_error_code"] = "AUTH_FAILED"
        conn["last_error_message"] = "Token rejected"
        conn["updated_at"] = now
        conns[idx] = conn
        _save("todoist_connections.json", conns)
        _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id}, "failed", http_status=401, error_code="UNAUTHORIZED", error_message="Authentication failed")
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Authentication failed", details={"http_status": 401})

    # success => status active
    if conn.get("status") not in ("active", "invalid_token"):
        _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id}, "failed", error_code="INVALID_TRANSITION", error_message="Illegal status transition")
        return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Illegal status transition")

    conn["status"] = "active"
    conn["last_validated_at"] = now
    conn["last_error_code"] = None
    conn["last_error_message"] = None
    conn["updated_at"] = now
    if conn.get("external_todoist_user_id") is None:
        # Populate a stable pseudo external user id derived from fingerprint without exposing secrets
        base = (fp or "unknown").strip()
        conn["external_todoist_user_id"] = ("usr_" + str(abs(hash(base)) % 10**12))
    conns[idx] = conn
    _save("todoist_connections.json", conns)

    resp = {
        "connection_id": connection_id,
        "ok": True,
        "http_status": 200,
        "status": conn.get("status"),
        "last_validated_at": conn.get("last_validated_at"),
        "external_todoist_user_id": conn.get("external_todoist_user_id"),
    }
    _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id}, "succeeded", http_status=200)
    return resp

tool_schemas.name: todoist_test_all_features
tool_schemas.description: Runs the MCP feature test suite for the given connection (read_only or write mode) and returns a structured report of checks performed, outcomes, and any created entity IDs; when cleanup is true, it attempts to remove test-created entities before returning. Validates mode and enforces that write mode may create/update/complete/delete tasks, projects, labels, sections, and comments as required by the suite. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the connection does not exist, CONFLICT if write mode is requested but the connection cannot perform mutations (for example, insufficient permissions or invalid token), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if test execution is blocked by configured rate/usage limits.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection ULID (todoist_connections.id) to run the full feature test suite against.

mode.description: Whether to run only non-mutating checks or include create/update/complete/delete operations.

cleanup.description: Whether to remove any test-created entities after the suite finishes.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def todoist_test_all_features(connection_id, mode=None, cleanup=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, random
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0360000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0360000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    suite_start = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _record_run(conn_id, req_params, status, http_status=None, error_code=None, error_message=None, assertions=None, tool_name="todoist_test_all_features"):
        runs = _load("todoist_tool_runs.json")
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        def _gen_ulid_like(prefix):
            return prefix + "_" + "".join(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(26))
        rid = _gen_ulid_like("tdrun")
        duration_ms = int((time.time() - suite_start) * 1000)
        row = {
            "id": rid,
            "connection_id": conn_id,
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "request_params": req_params,
            "status": status,
            "http_status": http_status,
            "error_code": error_code,
            "error_message": error_message,
            "duration_ms": duration_ms if status in ("succeeded", "failed") else None,
            "assertions": assertions,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        runs.append(row)
        _save("todoist_tool_runs.json", runs)

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(connection_id, str):
        _record_run("unknown", {"connection_id": connection_id, "mode": mode, "cleanup": cleanup}, "failed", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR", error_message="connection_id must be a string")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "connection_id must be a string")
    if not re.match(r"^tdc_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$", connection_id):
        _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id, "mode": mode, "cleanup": cleanup}, "failed", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR", error_message="connection_id format is invalid")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "connection_id format is invalid")
    if mode is None:
        mode = "read_only"
    if mode not in ("read_only", "write"):
        _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id, "mode": mode, "cleanup": cleanup}, "failed", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR", error_message="mode must be 'read_only' or 'write'")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "mode must be 'read_only' or 'write'")
    if cleanup is None:
        cleanup = True
    if not isinstance(cleanup, bool):
        _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id, "mode": mode, "cleanup": cleanup}, "failed", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR", error_message="cleanup must be boolean")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "cleanup must be boolean")

    # Resolve connection
    conns = _load("todoist_connections.json")
    conn = next((c for c in conns if c.get("id") == connection_id), None)
    if not conn:
        _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id, "mode": mode, "cleanup": cleanup}, "failed", error_code="NOT_FOUND", error_message="Connection not found")
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Connection not found")
    if conn.get("status") == "disabled":
        _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id, "mode": mode, "cleanup": cleanup}, "failed", error_code="UNAUTHORIZED", error_message="Connection is disabled")
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Connection is disabled")

    # Data
    containers = _load("todoist_containers.json")
    labels = _load("todoist_labels.json")
    tasks = _load("todoist_tasks.json")
    comments = _load("todoist_comments.json")

    alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
    def _gen(prefix):
        return prefix + "_" + "".join(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(26))

    assertions = []
    created = {"project_container_id": None, "section_container_id": None, "label_id": None, "task_id": None, "comment_id": None}

    def _assert(name, passed, details=None):
        assertions.append({"name": name, "passed": bool(passed), "details": details})

    # Read checks
    try:
        proj_count = sum(1 for c in containers if c.get("connection_id") == connection_id and c.get("type") == "project" and c.get("status") != "deleted")
        _assert("project_get_readable", True, {"projects_visible": proj_count})
    except Exception as e:
        _assert("project_get_readable", False, {"error": str(e)})

    try:
        lbl_count = sum(1 for l in labels if l.get("connection_id") == connection_id and l.get("status") != "deleted")
        _assert("label_get_readable", True, {"labels_visible": lbl_count})
    except Exception as e:
        _assert("label_get_readable", False, {"error": str(e)})

    try:
        active_task_count = sum(1 for t in tasks if t.get("connection_id") == connection_id and t.get("status") == "active")
        _assert("task_readable", True, {"active_tasks_visible": active_task_count})
    except Exception as e:
        _assert("task_readable", False, {"error": str(e)})

    if mode == "write":
        # Create project
        pname = "MCP Test Project"
        conflict = any(
            c.get("connection_id") == connection_id and c.get("type") == "project" and c.get("status") != "deleted"
            and isinstance(c.get("name"), str) and c.get("name").strip().lower() == pname.lower()
            for c in containers
        )
        if conflict:
            _assert("project_create_unique", False, {"message": "Project name already exists; cannot run write suite deterministically"})
        else:
            pid = _gen("tdctr")
            proj = {
                "id": pid,
                "connection_id": connection_id,
                "type": "project",
                "external_id": None,
                "name": pname,
                "parent_project_id": None,
                "color": None,
                "order_index": 0,
                "is_favorite": False,
                "status": "active",
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
            }
            containers.append(proj)
            created["project_container_id"] = pid
            _assert("project_create", True, {"project_container_id": pid})

        # Create section
        if created["project_container_id"]:
            sname = "MCP Test Section"
            conflict = any(
                c.get("connection_id") == connection_id and c.get("type") == "section" and c.get("status") != "deleted"
                and c.get("parent_project_id") == created["project_container_id"]
                and isinstance(c.get("name"), str) and c.get("name").strip().lower() == sname.lower()
                for c in containers
            )
            if conflict:
                _assert("section_create_unique", False, {"message": "Section name already exists in project"})
            else:
                sid = _gen("tdctr")
                sec = {
                    "id": sid,
                    "connection_id": connection_id,
                    "type": "section",
                    "external_id": None,
                    "name": sname,
                    "parent_project_id": created["project_container_id"],
                    "color": None,
                    "order_index": 0,
                    "is_favorite": False,
                    "status": "active",
                    "created_at": now,
                    "updated_at": now,
                }
                containers.append(sec)
                created["section_container_id"] = sid
                _assert("section_create", True, {"section_container_id": sid})
        else:
            _assert("section_create", False, {"message": "project not created"})

        # Create label
        lname = "mcp_test_label"
        conflict = any(
            l.get("connection_id") == connection_id and l.get("status") != "deleted"
            and isinstance(l.get("name"), str) and l.get("name").strip().lower() == lname.lower()
            for l in labels
        )
        if conflict:
            _assert("label_create_unique", False, {"message": "Label name already exists"})
        else:
            lid = _gen("tdlbl")
            lab = {
                "id": lid,
                "connection_id": connection_id,
                "external_id": None,
                "name": lname,
                "color": None,
                "is_favorite": False,
                "status": "active",
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
            }
            labels.append(lab)
            created["label_id"] = lid
            _assert("label_create", True, {"label_id": lid})

        # Create task
        content = "MCP Test Task"
        tid = _gen("tdtsk")
        # Validate label_ids exist and same connection
        label_ids = []
        if created["label_id"]:
            label_ids = [created["label_id"]]
        task = {
            "id": tid,
            "connection_id": connection_id,
            "external_id": None,
            "content": content,
            "description": "test description",
            "project_container_id": created["project_container_id"],
            "section_container_id": created["section_container_id"],
            "parent_task_id": None,
            "priority": 1,
            "due_date": None,
            "due_timezone": None,
            "due_string_raw": None,
            "deadline_at": None,
            "label_ids": label_ids,
            "status": "active",
            "completed_at": None,
            "deleted_at": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        # container type checks
        ok_cont = True
        if task["project_container_id"] is not None:
            pc = next((c for c in containers if c.get("id") == task["project_container_id"]), None)
            if not pc or pc.get("connection_id") != connection_id or pc.get("type") != "project":
                ok_cont = False
        if task["section_container_id"] is not None:
            sc = next((c for c in containers if c.get("id") == task["section_container_id"]), None)
            if not sc or sc.get("connection_id") != connection_id or sc.get("type") != "section":
                ok_cont = False
            if task["project_container_id"] is None:
                ok_cont = False
        if ok_cont:
            tasks.append(task)
            created["task_id"] = tid
            _assert("task_create", True, {"task_id": tid})
        else:
            _assert("task_create", False, {"message": "invalid project/section linkage"})

        # Create comment on task
        if created["task_id"]:
            cid = _gen("tdcmt")
            com = {
                "id": cid,
                "connection_id": connection_id,
                "external_id": None,
                "task_id": created["task_id"],
                "project_container_id": None,
                "content": "MCP test comment",
                "posted_at": None,
                "status": "active",
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
            }
            comments.append(com)
            created["comment_id"] = cid
            _assert("comment_create", True, {"comment_id": cid})
        else:
            _assert("comment_create", False, {"message": "task not created"})

        # Complete task (active -> completed)
        if created["task_id"]:
            trow = next((t for t in tasks if t.get("id") == created["task_id"]), None)
            if trow and trow.get("status") == "active":
                trow["status"] = "completed"
                trow["completed_at"] = now
                trow["updated_at"] = now
                _assert("task_complete", True, {"completed_at": now})
            elif trow and trow.get("status") == "completed":
                _assert("task_complete_idempotent", True, {"completed_at": trow.get("completed_at")})
            else:
                _assert("task_complete", False, {"message": "task not in completable state"})
        # Delete label and ensure removed from task label_ids
        if created["label_id"]:
            lrow = next((l for l in labels if l.get("id") == created["label_id"]), None)
            if lrow and lrow.get("status") == "active":
                lrow["status"] = "deleted"
                lrow["updated_at"] = now
                # remove from tasks
                for t in tasks:
                    if t.get("connection_id") == connection_id and isinstance(t.get("label_ids"), list):
                        if created["label_id"] in t["label_ids"]:
                            t["label_ids"] = [x for x in t["label_ids"] if x != created["label_id"]]
                            t["updated_at"] = now
                _assert("label_delete_and_detach", True, {"label_id": created["label_id"]})
            else:
                _assert("label_delete_and_detach", False, {"message": "label not deletable"})

        # Delete task (completed -> deleted)
        if created["task_id"]:
            trow = next((t for t in tasks if t.get("id") == created["task_id"]), None)
            if trow and trow.get("status") in ("active", "completed"):
                trow["status"] = "deleted"
                trow["deleted_at"] = now
                trow["completed_at"] = trow.get("completed_at") if trow.get("status") == "completed" else trow.get("completed_at")
                trow["updated_at"] = now
                _assert("task_delete", True, {"deleted_at": now})
            elif trow and trow.get("status") == "deleted":
                _assert("task_delete_idempotent", True, {"deleted_at": trow.get("deleted_at")})
            else:
                _assert("task_delete", False, {"message": "task missing"})

        # Persist writes done by suite
        _save("todoist_containers.json", containers)
        _save("todoist_labels.json", labels)
        _save("todoist_tasks.json", tasks)
        _save("todoist_comments.json", comments)

        # Cleanup: remove test-created entities (soft-delete where lifecycle allows)
        cleanup_report = {"attempted": bool(cleanup), "actions": []}
        if cleanup:
            # comments: active->deleted
            if created["comment_id"]:
                com = next((c for c in comments if c.get("id") == created["comment_id"] and c.get("connection_id") == connection_id), None)
                if com and com.get("status") == "active":
                    com["status"] = "deleted"
                    com["updated_at"] = now
                    cleanup_report["actions"].append({"comment_deleted": created["comment_id"]})
            # containers: active->deleted (project/section)
            if created["section_container_id"]:
                sec = next((c for c in containers if c.get("id") == created["section_container_id"] and c.get("connection_id") == connection_id), None)
                if sec and sec.get("status") in ("active", "archived"):
                    sec["status"] = "deleted"
                    sec["updated_at"] = now
                    cleanup_report["actions"].append({"section_deleted": created["section_container_id"]})
            if created["project_container_id"]:
                proj = next((c for c in containers if c.get("id") == created["project_container_id"] and c.get("connection_id") == connection_id), None)
                if proj and proj.get("status") in ("active", "archived"):
                    proj["status"] = "deleted"
                    proj["updated_at"] = now
                    cleanup_report["actions"].append({"project_deleted": created["project_container_id"]})
            _save("todoist_containers.json", containers)
            _save("todoist_comments.json", comments)
        else:
            cleanup_report = {"attempted": False}

    # Determine overall pass/fail
    passed = all(a.get("passed") for a in assertions) if assertions else True
    status = "succeeded" if passed else "failed"
    _record_run(connection_id, {"connection_id": connection_id, "mode": mode, "cleanup": cleanup}, status, http_status=200 if passed else 409, error_code=None if passed else "CONFLICT", error_message=None if passed else "One or more feature checks failed", assertions=assertions)

    return {
        "connection_id": connection_id,
        "mode": mode,
        "cleanup": cleanup,
        "passed": passed,
        "assertions": assertions,
        "created_entities": created,
    }

tool_schemas.name: todoist_test_performance
tool_schemas.description: Benchmarks selected operations against the given connection for the requested number of iterations (with optional warmup) and returns aggregated timing statistics per operation. Validates iterations/warmup_iterations minima and validates that each requested operation name is supported; operations are executed as specified and results are returned as a single report (no paging). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the connection does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if iterations < 1 or warmup_iterations < 0 or an operation is unsupported, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if benchmarking is blocked by configured rate/usage limits.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection ULID (todoist_connections.id) to benchmark.

iterations.description: Number of times to repeat each measured operation.

operations.description: Subset of operations to measure; defaults to a representative set if omitted.

warmup_iterations.description: Number of warmup runs to execute before timing begins.

The main workflows are CRUD + state transitions on tasks (create/update/complete/delete, bulk operations, hierarchy operations), plus managem
